_comment: DO NOT EDIT: generated deterministically from the readable sources in this repository.
name: Angels Fall First Dedicated Server
author: community@example.invalid
description: Community PTDL_v2 egg for Angels Fall First Dedicated Server App 407480 under Wine. Wine 11 launch, map load, UDP listeners, direct A2S query, and log readiness were observed; real-client acceptance remains unverified.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Public server name written to [AFFGame.AFFGameReplicationInfo]. Quotes, control characters, and path separators are rejected at runtime.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Public server description written to [AFFGame.AFFGameReplicationInfo].

variables.name: Message Of The Day
variables.description: Message shown to joining players; written as MessageOfTheDay in [AFFGame.AFFGameReplicationInfo].

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Required in-game administrator password for AdminLogin. No default is supplied; use a unique value of at least 8 characters.

variables.name: Default Map
variables.description: Initial map. The allowlist exactly matches the map packages observed in App 407480 build 25627237.

variables.name: Map Cycle
variables.description: Comma-separated installed map-package tokens with no spaces or quotes; converted to GameSpecificMapCycles in [UTGame.UTGame].

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query UDP port. Add this exact port as a separate Pterodactyl allocation; it must differ from the primary SERVER_PORT allocation.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum joining players from the documented MaxPlayers URL option.

variables.name: Minimum Bodies
variables.description: Minimum combined human and bot body count from NumPlay. The runtime also requires this not to exceed Maximum Players.

variables.name: Balance Bots
variables.description: Add bots to keep teams balanced. Accepted values are true and false.

variables.name: AI Level
variables.description: Bot difficulty from 1 through 5.

variables.name: Briefing Time
variables.description: Briefing phase duration in seconds. Zero skips the briefing.

variables.name: Random Commander
variables.description: Automatically assign command to Milnet AI. Accepted values are true and false.

variables.name: Red Starting Tickets
variables.description: Starting tickets for the ULA team; minimum 10.

variables.name: Blue Starting Tickets
variables.description: Starting tickets for the AIA team; minimum 10.

variables.name: Friendly Fire
variables.description: Friendly-fire percentage from 0 through 100. The developer warns this option was not extensively tested.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 asks start.sh to run a supervised anonymous Windows SteamCMD update before launch; 0 starts the installed build.

variables.name: Validate On Update
variables.description: 1 adds SteamCMD validate during automatic updates; 0 performs the normal update check.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Fixed Angels Fall First Dedicated Server App ID.

variables.name: Steam User
variables.description: The dedicated server installs anonymously.

variables.name: Windows Platform
variables.description: Forces the Windows Steam depot required by the Wine runtime.

variables.name: Wine Runtime Components
variables.description: Disables the Wine image entrypoint hook; start.sh conditionally installs vcrun2022 under its supervisor.

variables.name: Image Auto Update
variables.description: Fixed off so the Wine image entrypoint cannot update outside start.sh supervision.

variables.name: Wine Architecture
variables.description: Fixed 64-bit Wine prefix architecture.

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: Suppresses routine Wine debug channels.

variables.name: Wine Prefix
variables.description: Persistent Wine prefix used by the runtime image.
